d: Interpay builds the retail payment software that banks and merchants across Saudi Arabia depend on: POS and SoftPOS acceptance, e-commerce gateways, payment switching and merchant services. Our products handle cardholder data under SAMA regulation and PCI security standards, and they run around the clock.

Interpay's backend platform authorises, routes and settles card transactions at scale. As a Backend Engineer (.NET), you'll build and operate the services behind it: maintaining established ASP.NET applications on Windows and SQL Server, and building cloud-native services on modern .NET in Linux containers on Kubernetes. You'll report to the Development Manager.
q: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
4+ years of backend development, with production systems delivered
Strong C# across .NET Framework / ASP.NET and current .NET
ASP.NET MVC, dependency injection and repository patterns
Building and running services in Linux containers with Docker and Kubernetes
Solid SQL Server: schema design, stored procedures, indexing and query tuning
Designing and consuming REST APIs, and familiarity with gRPC or RPC
Agile delivery, and Git with pull-request and code-review workflows
Secure coding and the OWASP Top 10
Enough HTML5 and CSS3 to support server-rendered views
Willing and eligible to work on-site in Riyadh
Payments, fintech or banking experience, especially switching, acquiring, POS or e-commerce processing
ISO 8583 message construction, parsing and host interface development
EMV, tokenisation, HSM integration, DUKPT or TR-31 key blocks
Work in a PCI DSS or PCI Secure SLC certified environment
Kafka, RabbitMQ or similar messaging platforms
Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI, and infrastructure as code
Zero-downtime schema migrations with the expand-contract pattern
Engineering discipline: clean, tested, maintainable code and a high bar in code review
Security mindset: security and compliance are design inputs from the start
Ownership: you see services into production and support them once they're live
Analytical rigour: careful reasoning about correctness, concurrency and failure modes
Collaboration: clear communication across countries and time zones
Adaptability: comfortable moving between legacy maintenance and greenfield work
Full-time, on-site at our Riyadh office. You may join an on-call rotation and occasionally work outside standard hours to support production releases and incidents.
r: Requirements and design: work with product, architecture and internal stakeholders on sound software design
Modern .NET: build, containerise and deploy services on current .NET on Linux and Kubernetes, with twelve-factor principles, health checks, structured logging and observability from the start
Legacy ASP.NET: maintain and progressively modernise ASP.NET and ASP.NET MVC applications with the strangler and expand-contract patterns, without service disruption
APIs: design well-documented REST and gRPC APIs, and agree contracts with mobile and front-end developers
Data: design schemas, write efficient queries and tune performance on SQL Server and, as the platform migrates, distributed SQL (YugabyteDB / PostgreSQL)
Refactoring: pay down technical debt and keep improving resilience and maintainability
Implement and support authorisation, reversal, settlement and reconciliation flows
Work with ISO 8583 message handling and host interfaces to acquirers, schemes and processors
Support EMV transaction flows and tokenisation of cardholder data
Integrate with Hardware Security Modules, including DUKPT and TR-31 key blocks
Engineer for high throughput and low latency with idempotency, exactly-once semantics and safe retries
Build event-driven and asynchronous workflows on Kafka or RabbitMQ
Apply PCI DSS and PCI Secure SLC practices throughout development
Implement OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, mutual TLS, JWT handling and proper secrets management
Write unit, integration and contract tests, and support CI/CD, release, change control and rollback
Keep design notes, API specifications and runbooks current
Act as subject-matter expert for your applications: incident response, root cause analysis, and audit and pen-test remediation

d: Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career that will give you plenty of opportunities to develop, join HSBC and your future will be rich with potential.

Global Payments Solutions (GPS) is a core contributor to HSBC supporting Corporate and Insitituational customers across all segments. Our payments business connects clients worldwide and enables efficient movement of monies through cash management products across payables, receivables, clearing and foreign currency, liquidity solutions and corporate credit cards.

We are seeking an ambitious UAE Naitional who can join the GPS team in Dubai as the Senior Account Manager (SAM) who will be responsible for the global satisfaction of a portfolio of GPS clients. The purpose of this role is to ensure clients receive a superior service experience both locally and globally; to be a client’s single point of contact for service for those complex queries that are fall above and beyond basic transactional queries. The Senior Account Manager’s portfolio will be a mix of top tier, highly complex GPS clients and complex clients.
r: Manage liquidity and cash management requirements for a portfolio of multinational and local corporate clients, building strong relationships with Treasury and Finance stakeholders.
Retain and grow annual portfolio revenue by identifying client opportunities and recommending relevant cash management products and solutions.
Act as the primary escalation point for clients and internal stakeholders, ensuring effective resolution of service issues, risks and relationship concerns.
Lead and coordinate client retention and implementation initiatives, including global billing setups, file-format conversions and digital migration projects.
Proactively review client activity, service performance and existing solutions to improve the client experience, reduce errors and queries, strengthen controls and increase wallet share.
Monitor service-level metrics, payment flows, rejection and return rates, and other performance indicators; develop remedial actions and communicate insights through Client Service Reviews.
Collaborate with Operations, Technology, Sales and Relationship Managers while engaging client Treasury, Finance, Operations and IT teams to deliver coordinated, commercially focused outcomes.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following criteria:-
Strong expertise in local and global cash management, clearing services, corporate treasury operations, payments, foreign exchange and intercompany lending.

Proven ability to understand customer needs and align them with a broad range of products and services, supported by strong commercial awareness and knowledge of market, regulatory and competitor developments.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, analytical, planning and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple time-sensitive priorities effectively.
Relevant banking or relationship-management experience with corporates, multinational organisations or financial institutions, with flexibility and willingness to travel.

A full-time graduation degree of at least three years is essential for obtaining a UAE visa and/or work permit. For degrees obtained outside the UAE, valid attestations and equivalency are also mandatory
